-- m-rt/src/demo/BExec.java --
package demo;
import java.util.concurrent.*;
public class BExec extends BComponent
{
  private ExecutorService executorService;
  public void started() { executorService = Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor(); }
  public void stopped() { executorService.shutdownNow(); }
}
-- m-rt/src/demo/BLeak.java --
package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class BLeak extends BComponent {
  // a comment line
  private Clock.Ticket ticket;
  public void kick() {
    Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(1), kicked, null);
    ticket = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), armed, null);
    busy = true;
  }
  private boolean busy;
}
-- m-rt/src/demo/BMiss.java --
package demo;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
public final class BMiss extends BComponent {
  private Clock.Ticket a;
  public void arm() { a = Clock.schedule(this, BRelTime.makeSeconds(5), armed, null); }
  public void stopped() { other.cancel(); }
}
